compared.title: A module admitting a left dual in the monoidal category of modules is finite projective
compared.statement:
\label{lemma-left-dual-module}
Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be an $R$-module. Let  $N, \eta, \epsilon$
be a left dual of $M$ in the monoidal category of $R$-modules, see
Categories, Definition \ref{categories-definition-dual}. Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item $M$ and $N$ are finite projective $R$-modules,
\item the map
$e : \Hom_R(M, R) \to N$, $\lambda \mapsto (\lambda \otimes 1)(\eta)$
is an isomorphism,
\item we have $\epsilon(n, m) = e^{-1}(n)(m)$ for $n \in N$ and $m \in M$.
\end{enumerate}

compared.title: Coend reconstruction from an exact faithful finite-dimensional vector-space functor
compared.statement: Let C be a k-linear abelian category with an exact faithful functor F:C→FiniteVec. Then C is locally finite, and F defines an equivalence between C and finite dimensional right comodules over Coend(F).
